title: Bear cub wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='12' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='12' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='6' fill='#c98b52'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='6' fill='#c98b52'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#a86d38'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#e0b07a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#5a3518'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 62 Q50 68 44 69' stroke='#5a3518' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 62 Q50 68 56 69' stroke='#5a3518' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M42 44 Q50 40 58 44' stroke='#3a2a55' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>

  <rect x='30' y='40' width='16' height='12' rx='5' fill='#2c1f45'/>
  <rect x='54' y='40' width='16' height='12' rx='5' fill='#2c1f45'/>

  <path d='M33 45 L37 43' stroke='#8e7ab8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 45 L61 43' stroke='#8e7ab8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sunglasses: arms -->
  <path d='M30 44 L22 41' stroke='#3a2a55' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 44 L78 41' stroke='#3a2a55' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
